meta.name: problem-framing-canvas
meta.description: Guide teams through MITRE's Problem Framing Canvas. Use when you need a clearer problem statement before jumping to solutions.

copy.tagline: 引导团队用MITRE画布厘清问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队在跳入方案前需要明确问题定义。
copy.tagline_en: Guide teams through MITRE's canvas to frame the problem
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to clarify the problem before jumping to solutions.

howto.what: Claude 会引导你通过 MITRE Problem Framing Canvas 的三个阶段（向内看、向外看、重新定义），提问并收集信息，最终输出一个清晰的问题陈述和“How Might We”问题。
howto.when: 当你有一个模糊的问题或需求，希望在跳入解决方案之前先澄清问题定义时触发。

say.text: 请用 Problem Framing Canvas 梳理移动端用户留存问题。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成三个阶段的提问。

say.text: 我们收到了一个利益相关者的需求，帮我重新定义问题。
say.note: Claude 会组织流程，避免过早陷入解决方案。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through the three phases of the MITRE Problem Framing Canvas (Look Inward, Look Outward, Reframe) by asking structured questions and synthesizes a clear problem statement and 'How Might We' question.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a clearer problem statement before jumping to solutions, typically when faced with a vague problem or stakeholder request.

say_en.text: Use the Problem Framing Canvas to clarify our mobile retention issue.
say_en.note: Claude will lead the canvas process.

say_en.text: Help me reframe this stakeholder request before building anything.
say_en.note: Claude will conduct the canvas to avoid solution-first thinking.
